SPIREBROTHERS-KID.name: Kid
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOCKBEARD.name: Captain Blockbeard
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOCKBEARD.insults.0: My cutlass has seen more battles than you've had hot dinners!
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOCKBEARD.insults.1: I've built better crews out of dirt blocks!
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOCKBEARD.insults.2: You swing that thing like you're swatting flies!
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOCKBEARD.insults.3: Nobody has ever beaten me in a duel!
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOCKBEARD.insults.4: I'll have you swabbing my decks by sundown!
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOCKBEARD.insults.5: Every port on the sea knows my name!
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOCKBEARD.insults.6: My parrot is smarter than the lot of you!
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOCKBEARD.insults.7: This beard is square for a reason, and the reason is excellence!
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOCKBEARD.gloats.0: Ha! Not a peep! Another win for Blockbeard!
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOCKBEARD.gloats.1: Cat got your tongue? Or was it my parrot?
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOCKBEARD.gloats.2: Silence! The sweetest sound on the seven seas.
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOCKBEARD.gloats.3: I'll take that as a surrender.
SPIREBROTHERS-BLOCKBEARD.speechless.2: Hmph! I was going to say that!
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLIATH.name: Goliath
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLIATH.intro.0: Choose a champion, and send him down to me!
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLIATH.intro.1: Six cubits and a span! How tall are YOU?
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLIATH.intro.2: Is this the best your camp can send?
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLIATH.intro.3: Bring all your brothers. It won't help.
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLIATH.heroReply.2: Is that... is that a sling in your pocket?
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLIATH.heroReply.3: My forehead still hurts from last time!
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLIATH.heroReply.4: Am I a dog, that you come at me with sticks?
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLIATH.taunts.0: Forty days I've stood here! Is nobody coming?
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLIATH.taunts.1: I defy the lot of you!
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLIATH.taunts.2: Come here, and I'll feed you to the birds!
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLIATH.taunts.3: Morning and evening! Every day! Still waiting!
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLIATH.taunts.4: Look at the size of this spear!
SPIREBROTHERS-GOLIATH.heroWin.3: Five smooth stones, and I only ever need one.

SPIREBROTHERS-LIONESS.moves.ROAR.title: Roar
SPIREBROTHERS-LIONESS.moves.POUNCE.title: Pounce
SPIREBROTHERS-LIONESS.moves.MAUL.title: Maul
SPIREBROTHERS-LIONS_DEN.intro.2: They rolled a stone over the door. Nobody's leaving.
SPIREBROTHERS-LIONS_DEN.heroReply.0: ...Is that the guy who prays three times a day?
SPIREBROTHERS-LIONS_DEN.heroReply.1: Wait. Not HIM. We couldn't open our mouths last time!
SPIREBROTHERS-LIONS_DEN.heroReply.2: Nobody said it was going to be him.
SPIREBROTHERS-LIONS_DEN.taunts.2: Haven't eaten since the king's last decree!
SPIREBROTHERS-LIONS_DEN.heroWin.0: Same as last time. Not a scratch.
SPIREBROTHERS-LIONS_DEN.heroWin.2: Told you. I've done this before.
SPIREBROTHERS-LIONS_DEN.heroWin.3: My God shut the lions' mouths. Works every time.
SPIREBROTHERS-WALL_OF_JERICHO.name: The Wall of Jericho
SPIREBROTHERS-JERICHO_GUARD.name: Jericho Guard
SPIREBROTHERS-JERICHO_ARCHER.name: Jericho Archer
SPIREBROTHERS-JERICHO.intro.1: The gates are shut. Go home.
SPIREBROTHERS-JERICHO.intro.2: Walking in circles won't help you!
SPIREBROTHERS-JERICHO.heroIntro.0: Seven times around? I brought my guitar.
SPIREBROTHERS-JERICHO.heroReply.1: Oh no. Not the music guy.
SPIREBROTHERS-JERICHO.taunts.0: Our walls are thick and our arrows are sharp!
SPIREBROTHERS-JERICHO.taunts.2: Is that the best song you've got?
SPIREBROTHERS-JERICHO.taunts.3: Was that a crack? That wasn't a crack.
SPIREBROTHERS-JERICHO.heroWin.0: And the walls came a-tumblin' down.
SPIREBROTHERS-JERICHO.heroWin.1: Thank you, thank you. I'll be here all week.
SPIREBROTHERS-JERICHO.heroWin.3: That's what I call a bridge.
SPIREBROTHERS-ALEXANDER.name: Alexander the Coppersmith
SPIREBROTHERS-COPPER_AUTOMATON.name: Copper Automaton
SPIREBROTHERS-ALEXANDER.intro.0: Copper, bronze, and much harm! What can I make for you?
SPIREBROTHERS-ALEXANDER.intro.1: My constructs don't sleep, don't eat, and don't take breaks.
SPIREBROTHERS-ALEXANDER.heroIntro.0: Alexander the coppersmith. Paul warned me about you.
SPIREBROTHERS-ALEXANDER.heroReply.1: Paul! Did he mention I charge by the hour?
SPIREBROTHERS-ALEXANDER.heroReply.2: Paul talks too much. Write that in your letter.
SPIREBROTHERS-ALEXANDER.heroReply.3: A builder, are you? Let's compare work.
SPIREBROTHERS-ALEXANDER.taunts.0: Another one, fresh off the anvil!
SPIREBROTHERS-ALEXANDER.taunts.3: I have a forge and all afternoon.
SPIREBROTHERS-ALEXANDER.heroWin.0: The Lord will repay him for his deeds. Today's a good start.
SPIREBROTHERS-ALEXANDER.heroWin.3: Sloppy welds. I'd have drafted it better.

SPIREBROTHERS-LOOKOUT.moves.JAB.title: Spyglass Jab
SPIREBROTHERS-LOOKOUT.insults.0: I've seen barnacles with better footwork!
SPIREBROTHERS-LOOKOUT.insults.1: From up the mast, you all look like shrimp!
SPIREBROTHERS-LOOKOUT.insults.2: Land ho! Oh wait, that's just your ugly mug.
SPIREBROTHERS-LOOKOUT.insults.3: The captain's parrot fights better than you!
SPIREBROTHERS-LOOKOUT.insults.4: You smell like a bilge on a hot day!
SPIREBROTHERS-LOOKOUT.insults.5: I spy, with my little eye... a coward!

SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.name: Apophis
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.moves.KNEEL.title: Kneel Before Your God!
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.moves.RISE.title: Rise
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.intro.2: My Jaffa will make an example of you.
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.heroIntro.0: Okay, everyone stay calm. I speak Goa'uld. Mostly.
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.heroIntro.1: Hi! Daniel. Daniel Jackson. Well... basically.
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.heroIntro.2: Let me talk to him first. This always works.
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.heroIntro.3: I've seen every episode. I know how this ends.
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.heroReply.0: You dare speak to a god?
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.heroReply.2: Your words mean nothing to me.
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.heroReply.3: You will be the first to kneel.
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.sideReply.2: Personal shield. Lots of little hits.
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.sideReply.3: Break the sarcophagus. Trust me on this.
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.sideReply.4: I've done the math. The box goes first.
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.kara.0: Feel the power of a god.
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.kara.1: This will hurt. A great deal.
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.interrupted.3: That's what you get for monologuing.
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.rise.1: Did you think a god could die?
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.heroWin.0: Told you. He loses every season.
SPIREBROTHERS-APOPHIS.heroWin.3: Chevron seven, locked. Let's go home.

SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.name: Ba'al
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.moves.ZAT_BLAST.title: Zat Blast
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.moves.SMIRK.title: Smirk
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.intro.0: Oh good, visitors. Which one of me would you like to speak to?
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.intro.1: Don't bother guessing. We're all very handsome.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.intro.2: Welcome to Ba'al Industries. Please leave your Gold at the door.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.heroIntro.0: Okay. One of these is real. I've done the math.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.heroIntro.1: Three Ba'als. Same stats. Love it.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.heroReply.1: Ah. The one who counts everything.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.heroReply.2: I see you've brought a calculator. Adorable.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.heroReply.3: Your Gold is already on our balance sheet.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.sideReply.0: He's always the one in the middle. Probably.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.sideReply.1: Hit them all. Sort it out later.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.sideReply.3: How many of him ARE there?
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.taunts.1: I'm getting bored. All of me.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.taunts.2: Do you have any idea how many of me there are?
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.taunts.3: Was that supposed to hurt? Asking for a friend. Me.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.taunts.4: I'd say 'I'll be back,' but I never really left.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.takeover.1: Ba'al Industries thanks you for your investment.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.takeover.3: Your Gold. My Gold. Same thing, really.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.found.1: You found me. Now I'm annoyed.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.arrive.1: Sorry I'm late. I was busy being me.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.arrive.2: Another one? Don't mind if I do.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.arrive.3: I'm the real one. Trust me.
SPIREBROTHERS-BAAL.heroWin.1: And I'll be taking my Gold back, thanks.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.name: Anubis
SPIREBROTHERS-KULL_WARRIOR.name: Kull Warrior
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.intro.0: I am Anubis. Your gods have abandoned you.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.intro.1: The Ascended cast me out. You will not be so lucky.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.intro.2: Kneel, and I may let you serve.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.heroIntro.0: Okay. Hood guy. No face. This is fine.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.heroIntro.1: Big bad of the middle seasons. Let's do this.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.heroIntro.2: I've got the anti-Kull thing. I think. Which end is the front?
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.heroIntro.3: Hey, Anubis. Nice robe. Is anybody in there?
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.heroReply.2: Even the Goa'uld fear me. What are you?
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.heroReply.3: Look closer. You will not like what you find.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.sideReply.0: Kill the Kull first. He needs a body.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.sideReply.1: Hit the armor guys with the not-attacks.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.sideReply.2: Watch that countdown. That's the big one.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.taunts.1: I have been to the other side. You will not like it.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.taunts.3: There is no hiding from me.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.possess.0: Did you think a body could hold me?
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.possess.2: I cannot die. I can only change.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.superweapon.0: Witness the power of the Ancients.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.noHosts.0: That's the last Kull! Nowhere left to hide!
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.noHosts.1: No more bodies. Now he's ours.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.heroWin.1: There was nobody in there after all.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.heroWin.2: Back to the higher plane with you.
SPIREBROTHERS-ANUBIS.heroWin.3: Chevron seven, locked. We're going home.
